title: Part Four: How It Actually Runs

sections.brief: Two subjects: the Holy See (signs treaties, holds relations with 184 states) and Vatican City State (0.44 km² territory, 673 citizens, 882 residents); Lateran Arts. 2, 3, 13–16; extraterritorial properties; which one signs what. Figures: fig-compare, fig-stats

Fundamental Law 1929, 2000, 13 May 2023 and Leo XIV's law of 31 July 2026; the Pope's full legislative, executive and judicial power; Pontifical Commission, Governorate, Secretary General; Petrini and the November 2025 change. Figures: fig-time, fig-compare

Citizenship by office (Law CXXXI 2011): who gets it, how it lapses, numbers; residents; courts (single judge, Tribunal, Appeal, Cassation), 2020, 2021, 2023 reforms, Becciu status; Lateran Art. 22, Italian prisons, Gabriele and Ağca. Figures: fig-stats, fig-flow

Euro under the 2009 Monetary Agreement (coin ceiling, 51% at face value, Art. 8 AML); Lateran Arts. 6, 17, 20; untaxed salaries, VAT-free shops and the 2017 cigarette decision; water, rail, post, energy (Fratello Sole); FAS, Bambino Gesù and the Forlanini plan; police and Swiss Guard.
